evidence_quotes: vergunning op grond van de Waterwet voor activiteiten die verband houden met nieuwe woningbouw in de Spoorlaanzone
voorschrift dat de demping van 120m2 overig oppervlaktewater pas mag plaatsvinden nadat daarvoor is gecompenseerd
rationale: The decision directly adjudicates an appeal against a permit issued under the Dutch Water Act (vergunning op grond van de Waterwet) for activities related to new housing construction, annulling the decision insofar as it lacked a permit condition requiring prior water compensation before filling in (demping) 120 m2 of surface water. This squarely constitutes a water law regulatory permit dispute (WATER / regulatory_permit) and does not involve household service connection refusal or informal settlement water access.
